housing: Melton is a rural borough centred on the market town of Melton Mowbray, with dozens of villages across the Wolds and the Vale of Belvoir. Rented homes are mostly terraces and semis in Melton Mowbray, alongside cottages and farmhouses in the villages. Many rural homes are built of ironstone or old brick and are off mains gas.
checkinTips: Ironstone and older brick cottages in the villages: photograph damp patches, flaking plaster and condensation in cold rooms.
Rural homes off mains gas: photograph the oil tank or LPG bottles, gauge levels and the boiler service label.
Victorian terraces in Melton Mowbray: record the rear yard, outbuildings, gutters and any damp in back kitchens.
Homes near the River Eye and River Wreake: note any signs of past flooding on floors and lower walls.
Farm and barn conversions: record septic tanks or private drainage, gates, fencing and outbuildings included in the let.
tenantHelp: Tenants with disrepair or safety concerns can contact Melton Borough Council's environmental health team, which deals with private housing standards.
